decision: NARROWED BEYOND CAUSAL-STATE AND BISIMULATION QUOTIENT IDENTIFICATION — NOT ADOPTED

primary_prior_art.title: Learning Causal State Representations of Partially Observable Environments

finding: When target meaning is defined by equality of all admissible controlled future laws, the target quotient is a causal-state or bisimulation quotient covered by existing predictive-state and state-abstraction theory. A partition finer than the complete declared controlled process is observationally non-identifiable without an additional independent consequence or convention.
correction_to_previous_boundary: The generic predictive-state-to-semantic-quotient gap from C069 is substantially closed for operational behavioral semantics. Remaining claims must distinguish controlled predictive quotient, task-relative bisimulation quotient, and extra-behavioral ontology or external orientation.
next_gate: Preregister and reproduce a language-blind causal-state or bisimulation baseline with direct partition metrics before any new architecture. Any finer semantic distinction must be separated by a preregistered independent held-out consequence.
